Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 532 of 2024
Applicant :- Rekha Devi

Opposite Party :- State Of Up Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Sunil Kr. Sonkar, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2.  The instant application has been seeking a direction to Additional Civil Judge (S.D.)-I, Bareilly to consider and decide the Case No. 617 of 2020 (State vs. Prem Prakash and others), u/s 498A, 323,
504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Bhuta, District Bareilly, arising out of Case Crime No. 363 of 2019, within a stipulated period.
3. Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that he wants to withdraw the present application with liberty to file the same at appropriate stage.
4.
